title: कृष्ण और सुदामा
style: Stylised 3D animated film still, Pixar-like Indian devotional animation, warm cinematic lighting, soft volumetric light, rich detail, expressive faces, 16:9, no text, no watermark, no captions.

sudama.look: Sudama: a thin, poor Brahmin man about 40 years old, kind gentle face, short grey-black beard, shaved head with a small tuft (shikha), sandalwood tilak on forehead, wearing a torn and patched faded white dhoti and a thin worn cotton shawl, barefoot, no crown, no jewellery

krishna.look: Lord Krishna as Dwarkadhish: an adult man about 30 years old (not a child), tall, adult proportions, mature handsome face, soft blue skin, large loving eyes, black curly hair, golden crown with a peacock feather, yellow silk dhoti (pitambar), rich gold jewellery, pearl necklace, gentle smile, faint golden halo

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: द्वारका के महल के द्वार पर, एक गरीब ब्राह्मण खड़ा था।
scenes.image: Wide shot: {sudama} standing small and humble at the huge golden gate of a magnificent golden palace of Dwarka, guards in the background, sea and morning sky, he looks up in awe, holding a tiny cloth bundle of rice.

scenes.speaker: sudama
scenes.text: मैं कृष्ण का बचपन का मित्र हूँ। क्या वो मुझे पहचानेंगे?
scenes.image: Front-facing medium close-up portrait of {sudama} looking at the camera, shy and worried, the golden palace gate softly blurred behind him. Clear frontal face, mouth closed, head and shoulders in frame.

scenes.speaker: krishna
scenes.text: सुदामा! मेरे प्यारे मित्र, तुम आ गए!
scenes.image: Front-facing medium close-up portrait of {krishna} looking at the camera with overjoyed eyes full of happy tears, inside a glowing golden palace hall, soft background blur. Clear frontal face, mouth closed, head and shoulders in frame.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: कृष्ण नंगे पाँव दौड़े, और मित्र को गले लगा लिया।
scenes.image: {krishna} warmly embracing {sudama} at the palace gate, both with closed eyes and tears of joy, golden light, flower petals falling, palace guards and queens watching in surprise, emotional medium-wide shot.

scenes.speaker: sudama
scenes.text: प्रभु, मेरे पास देने को बस यह मुट्ठी भर चावल है।
scenes.image: Front-facing medium close-up portrait of {sudama} looking at the camera, embarrassed and humble, holding up the tiny open cloth bundle of plain rice near his chest, warm palace light. Clear frontal face, mouth closed.

scenes.speaker: krishna
scenes.text: प्रेम से दिया एक दाना भी, मेरे लिए पूरे संसार से बड़ा है।
scenes.image: Front-facing medium close-up portrait of {krishna} looking at the camera with deep love, holding a few grains of rice in his open palm, soft golden halo, palace hall softly blurred. Clear frontal face, mouth closed.
